```yaml
name: Blob Size Policy

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-blob-size:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for large blobs
        run: |
          # Define maximum allowed file size in bytes (e.g., 10MB)
          MAX_SIZE=10485760
          
          # Find files larger than MAX_SIZE, excluding .git directory
          LARGE_FILES=$(find . -type f -size +${MAX_SIZE}c -not -path './.git/*' -print)
          
          if [ -n "$LARGE_FILES" ]; then
            echo "::error::Found files larger than 10MB:"
            echo "$LARGE_FILES"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "No large files found."
          fi
```
